sections.content: The choice depends on the expression that follows. Use *desde* *hace* with a duration: desde hace *tres* *meses*, desde hace dos años. Use desde with a starting point: desde el *año* *pasado*, desde *enero*, desde el lunes. Both expressions connect the past to the present. Ask yourself whether you are naming how long or when the activity started.

items.spanish: Vivo aquí desde hace tres meses.
items.english: I have lived here for three months.
I have lived here since January.

items.spanish: Estudio español desde hace un año.
items.english: I have studied Spanish for a year.

items.spanish: Estudio español desde el año pasado.
items.english: I have studied Spanish since last year.
